svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Trucks already on the highway
svg.desc: Illustration of three trucks on a highway heading to a building marked launch, each carrying one supply layer. The door is their need date, the start of the next layer, not launch day; at the door, turn-up is a crew working at a rate, not a truck. Below, a ladder of lead times: land, shell and power in years; long-haul network in months to years; machines and parts in quarters; turn-up in weeks per job; placement from minutes to days. Turn-up and order-to-dock times have no published values.
svg.text: Up to “five years” for your own buildings; “10 minutes” for a small cloud service [6]
need date: the next layer's start
weeks per job; months to staff
physical: with the order or at turn-up
Lead times as described in Section 6.2; public values in Appendix B
